hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.1]

layout_and_grid.hero_layout: Asymmetric 12-column layout (7-col text/actions left, 5-col interactive live bot/QR console right)
layout_and_grid.feature_layout: Bento Grid (12 cols) with 8-span hero visual card, 4-span metric card, and staggered 4-span feature blocks with 1px border highlights
layout_and_grid.steps_layout: Vertical Process Rail with interactive step switching and terminal preview instead of repetitive standard 4-card grid

secret_swap_modal.backdrop: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-black/80 border border-white/10 shadow-2xl z-50
secret_swap_modal.deposit_card: Inner solid surface #0E131F with 1px subtle stroke, integrated copy-address button, single-use indicator, and dynamic QR render

privacy_toggles.style: Interactive toggle cards for Blend-In, Split-Routes, and Zero-Trace with glowing borders on state activate

motion_and_microinteractions.transitions: transition-all duration-200 ease-out (specific properties only, exclude global transform-all)
motion_and_microinteractions.status_pulse: Framer Motion layout transition when status updates from Waiting -> Detected -> Swapping -> Delivered
motion_and_microinteractions.copy_feedback: Instant checkmark morph + soft cyan flash on click

instructions_to_main_agent: Note: Files are JavaScript (.js), not TypeScript (.tsx). Use standard React hooks and standard JSX syntax.
Do NOT use pure transparent backgrounds for nav headers, drop-downs, or modals. Always enforce dark blur overlay or solid fallback.
Avoid generic centered AI layouts. Implement the Swiss asymmetrical grid for the hero and Bento feature layout for privacy highlights.
For the Secret Swap Modal: Ensure real-time state transitions are ultra-smooth using Framer Motion layout animations.
Include explicit data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, logos, tabs, status indicators) for reliable automated testing.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.data_testid_requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid (kebab-case).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_emoji_icons: NEVER use emoji characters for UI icons. Use lucide-react or phosphor icons.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.contrast_and_focus: Hover states must explicitly set text color. Focus rings must be high contrast cyan/blue.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing: Maintain 2-3x padding inside containers with borders to prevent text collision.
